subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.FT.------C.CONT.
description: Second diagram on page 110 (ALT(FT)II-4). The crossing diagrams how extended-functionalism structurally meets composite-continuance at the projectional-strain scale: EXT-FT (extended functionalism) crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance). EXT-FT sits at left; C-CONT at upper-right as partner-axis. AFI-2 (affinity insight, second degree) upper-left, DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) upper-center, F (form) upper-center. TECH-DY (technological dynamics) right. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) lower-left, RT-ALGN (reality alignment) center, MTH (methodology) lower-center-right. INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) at bottom. Structural argument: when extended-functionalism is crossed with composite-continuance, DYM-SPT and F rise from the main line as separate branches, and AFI-2 branches from the DYM-SPT line. TECH-DY branches from the main line on the right, with MTH branching from the TECH-DY line. The lower chain VT-DY -> RT-ALGN -> INDIV-DY carries vibrational-dynamics through reality-alignment into individual dynamics, the subject's downward output.
